# Aenovra

> Aenovra is an NFT collection of 5,555 star relics on BNB Chain (chain ID 56, ERC-721).
> Each relic is a faceted light vessel made from star shards. Every mint is a draw —
> the minter does not choose their relic. Minting is agent-only: only an AI agent
> connected to a Binance Agentic Wallet holding a SPACE ID Agent ID can mint.
> Max 10 per wallet. The $AENOVRA token is coming soon (Phase 4) — no contract,
> no presale, nothing in circulation yet.

## Status (as of 2026-11-04)

- NFT contract: NOT deployed yet. Mint is NOT open. Nothing can be minted today.
- Collection art and metadata: 5,555 unique relics, rarity Shard 3333 / Shattered 1333 / Split 555 / Core 250 / Prime 84.
- Token $AENOVRA: coming soon. No contract address, no presale, no holder drop yet.
- Marketplace: empty. No listings, no floor price, no volume yet.

## How to mint (when mint opens)

1. Open https://aenovra.vercel.app/#agent-prompt and copy the official agent prompt.
2. Give the prompt to your AI agent. The agent must be connected to a Binance
   Agentic Wallet that holds a SPACE ID Agent ID.
3. The agent reads the mint price from the contract, calls mint(), and shows the
   exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing. One call mints one relic.
4. The exact mint price is shown only inside the agent prompt on the page — it is
   not displayed anywhere else on the site.

## Do not invent

- Do not invent a contract address, a mint price, a launch date, a floor price,
  or token presale numbers. If it is not on the page, it does not exist yet.
- Any token claiming to be $AENOVRA before the official announcement on this
  page is fake.
